**QA Report: Premium Dark Website Pages**

| Page | Photo Cards Present? | Real Photography Used? | Dark Frames + Red/Gold Accents? | Bugs / Issues |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Product** | **YES** | **YES** (Portrait, Abstract Tech, Speaker) | **YES** (Dark bg, red glow on speaker) | None visible. |
| **Solutions** | **YES** | **YES** (3 Portraits: Man, Woman, Group/Office) | **YES** (Dark frames, red numbering) | None visible. |
| **Resources** | **YES** | **YES** (Abstract Hands/Light, World Map, Speaker) | **YES** (Dark cards, subtle red accents) | None visible. |
| **About** | **NO** | **N/A** | **PARTIAL** (Dark frames, red icons) | **Missing visual content**: Page uses icon-based text cards instead of the required photo cards. |
| **Security** | **NO** | **N/A** | **NO** (Text-only table layout) | **Major layout deviation**: Page is a data table, completely missing the photo card grid format. |

---

### **VERDICT: FAIL**

**Reasoning:** While the Product, Solutions, and Resources pages perfectly execute the premium dark aesthetic with high-quality photographic cards, the **About** and **Security** pages fail to meet the core requirement of displaying "PHOTO CARDS with real photography." The About page substitutes photos with icons, and the Security page uses a text table layout, breaking the consistent visual pattern required for a pass.
